acquisition method: A data-dependent procedure that alternated between one MS scan followed by 20 MS/MS scans with 20.0 s dynamic exclusion.
cleavage agent: The tryptic peptides were dissolved in 0.1% formic acid (solvent A)
collision energy: The precursors were fragmented in CID with collision energy from 20ev–59ev; Peptides were then selected for MS/MS using NCE setting as 28
enrichment method: HLA-peptide complexes were purified and subjected to mass spectrometry (MS)
fractionation method: The enriched HLA class Ι Hepatitis B virus peptides samples after fractional processing was resolved in buffer A
fragmentation method: The precursors were fragmented in CID with collision energy from 20ev–59ev
instrument: while a timsTOF Pro2 mass spectrometer (Bruker DaltonicsTM) was coupled online with the nanoElute; tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q ExactiveTM Plus (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS)
labeling: no labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
mass analyzer: intact peptides were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 70,000
precursor tolerance: with a precursor mass tolerance 20 ppm and fragment mass tolerance 0.05 Da; with a precursor mass tolerance 10 ppm and fragment mass tolerance 0.02 Da
fragment tolerance: with a precursor mass tolerance 20 ppm and fragment mass tolerance 0.05 Da; with a precursor mass tolerance 10 ppm and fragment mass tolerance 0.02 Da
ptm: variable Methionine oxidation (+15.995 Da); variable N-terminal Methionine Met-loss (−131.040 Da); variable Met-loss + Acetyl (−89.030 Da); variable N-terminal acetylation (+42.011 Da)

Methionine oxidation (+15.995 Da) was set as variable modifications; Methionine oxidation (+15.995 Da), N-terminal Methionine Met-loss (−131.040 Da), Met-loss + Acetyl (−89.030 Da) and N-terminal acetylation (+42.011 Da) were set as variable modifications
